newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Selamat sees 1997 net at 22.3 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Selamat sees 1997 net at 22.3 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian automobile spare-parts manufacturer PT Selamat Sampurna said on Tuesday it expected to post net profit of 22.3 billion rupiah in 1997 and net profit growth of 20 percent in 1998 on the basis of strong exports.

"The net profit growth for 1998 is expected to be around 20 percent, while this year we expect to book a 22.3 billion rupiah net profit," finance director Johansyah Anwar told Reuters. He added the firm posted net profit of some 18 billion rupiah in 1996.
Anwar said the firm expected its exports of automotive spare-parts, including fuel tanks, radiators and car filters, to continue boosting its performance in the coming years.
Sampurna exported around 40 percent of its production in 1996 and expected to increase the percentage in the coming years, Anwar said.
Anwar said the firm recently signed a memorandum of understanding to supply privately-owned PT Bakrie Motors, which plans to launch attractively priced cars in the domestic market later this year.
